title: Single-byte XOR brute force
signals: binary file with no known magic
preconditions: the whole payload was XORed with one repeated byte
steps: read the bytes, not the text
keep candidates containing a flag marker or printable English
confirm by re-XORing the candidate with the key
falsifier: no key yields a printable structure or marker; the key may be multi-byte
pitfalls: multi-byte keys are a different attack
UTF-8 decode can hide a valid binary hit
